coverage.edge: all-zeros (0 bytes) / all-ones ((2^k-1) mask) / MSB-first ordering
coverage.k_sweep: 2..8 bit-exact vs GR (whole groups) + trailing partial dropped (k=3/5/7)
coverage.mutation: LSB-first / wrong k / dropped bit / inverted / +1 shift / empty
coverage.lsb_mask: input LSB only (GR d_bits & 1), stray high bits ignored
coverage.decision: byte = MSB-first pack of k input LSBs; floor(nin/k) bytes (GR-exact)
coverage.note: 1-cell bit-serial packer; BIT-EXACT vs pack_k_bits_bb, delay 0, tol 0
coverage.hw_range: k in 1..8 (packs into one byte); out-of-range RAISES
